author: PC Gamer
text:
One of Elden Ring's top sleuths has already unmasked its new DLC characters
You look familiar.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After the debacle of Cyberpunk 2077, CD Projekt says The Witcher 4 is already running on PC and consoles, promises 'it's going to run' on all target platforms
Sure, it's a low bar, but after the Cyberpunk 2077 fiasco you can understand why CD Projekt Red would want to make the point.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Blizzard doing 'a thorough scrub' of illegitimate World of Warcraft Mythic-Plus dungeon rankings, with more changes to come
Paid boosting was particularly controversial in this instance, because it pushed legitimate records out of the top-1% reward category.

author: PC Gamer
text:
CD Projekt Red opens its 'Arasaka hardware archives' to help an indie dev whose gear was stolen during 1 of at least 4 Gamescom thefts
In a statement, Gamescom organizers said attendees "are advised to insure equipment against theft."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Empulse and Splitgate: Arena Reloaded are officially over as 1047 Games says it's probably done making arena shooters
The studio will remain operational, but its next game "may look very different" from what it's done before.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Some of WoW's hardest dungeons and raids have gotten just a bit easier—that's on purpose, developers say
"People are a little bit more willing now to say, 'Well I'd like to try out tanking. I'd like to try out healing.'"

author: PC Gamer
text:
Haunted Chocolatier's development has been 'very productive' in recent months, Eric Barone says: 'Working on Haunted Chocolatier is what I’m most eager and driven to do'
The Stardew developer says he's now "certain" he'll enjoy Haunted Chocolatier once it's finished.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I added player-seeking hit squads to GTA 5, though the billion other mods I have installed keep getting in their way
47 never had this problem.

author: PC Gamer
text:
With GTA 6 leaker hunt 'rapidly evolving,' Take-Two asks court to keep latest subpoena request sealed to avoid tipping off leakers
The filing contains "highly sensitive, confidential information" that lawyers fear could help the GTA 6 leakers destroy evidence or evade detection.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Blood of Dawnwalker review
A horror RPG with novel ideas of its own, even if it doesn’t always have the courage to follow them through.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Onimusha: Way of the Sword review
Ferociously good combat brings this long-dormant series back from the afterlife.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Fable's story will be '15-20 hours' long, according to its game director, although the game's life systems are 'limitless'
"You can literally play it forever if that's what you want to do."

author: PC Gamer
text:
A 38-year-old NES platformer is getting a Steam remake by its original husband-and-wife team, as the pair's 'final major game product'
The Battle of Olympus will arrive on Steam in 2027.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Steam 'teraleak' extends far beyond Valve games, including prototypes of third-party titles like Mafia 2 and Grand Theft Auto 3: 'This may be one of if not the biggest leaks to occur'
Hundreds of Steam file groups were included in the leak relating to game builds, trailers, soundtracks and more.

author: PC Gamer
text:
1666: Amsterdam's developer says it 'won't be using any AI anymore', and the tech was only used 'in conception and pre-production'—arguably the most creative phase of the entire process
Patrice Désilets says AI has been "totally removed" from the development process.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Steam Week in Review: Here are the top 10 most popular genres on Steam
All the interesting Steam facts for the week ending August 30.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Sidequests are almost my reason for doing videogames in the first place:' The dev behind one of the coolest upcoming RPGs says its word count is ballooning because they just love side stories so much
You won't see me complaining

author: PC Gamer
text:
A Star Wars Galaxies community server was allegedly hacked with AI assistance by a Reddit moderator harboring a primeval grudge
"We’re obviously bothered by this, but there isn’t much we can do outside of being up front with all of you and staying focused on what makes Legends great."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Star Wars Zero Company's permadeath makes it a better RPG than most RPGs, even though it's not really an RPG
Choice and consequence vs. death and consequence.

text:

author: PC Gamer
text:

Rebel Wolves' vampire RPG is holding an aggregate 83 score on Metacritic.

author: PC Gamer
text:
5 top tips from World of Warcraft housing creators for making amazing masterworks
Improve your housing game with advice from some of WoW's best home designers.

author: PC Gamer
text:
That Grand Theft Auto 6 exclusive reveal worked out pretty well for Netflix: It was the platform's biggest show last week
The GTA 6 reveal showcase pulled in more than 31 million views over just four days.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The future of GTA roleplaying remains in GTA 5 for now, as Rockstar touts new invite-only Nopixel V RP server
Rockstar collaborated with Nopixel Studios for the latest version of its custom GTA 5 roleplaying experience, which includes 1,000 ownable properties.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy review
Rat's all, folks.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Sick: Ace Combat 8 has online airbase lobbies where you can bum around as your own bespoke pilotsona
Unfortunately, it also has battle passes. War is hell.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Ken and Ryu work things out in a new trailer for Street Fighter
And Cody Rhodes isn't happy about what happened to his face.

author: PC Gamer
text:
GTA 6's story is too important for Rockstar to let you swap between Lucia and Jason whenever you want
Outside of the story, however, you'll be free to swap whenever.

author: PC Gamer
text:
August was a milestone month if you love watching robots completely eat it
The World Robot Humanoid Games gave us more footage of malfunctioning robots than we know what to do with.

author: PC Gamer
text:
No Rest for the Wicked, which was slated to hit 1.0 a month before Grand Theft Auto 6, is delayed into 2027
Moon Studios said the extra time will "help us improve performance, tighten the class system, and polish the whole game," and made no mention at all of GTA 6.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Dwarf Fortress creator says we can learn something from simply walling up dwarf nobles to maintain an equal society—but notes you have to abolish the dwarf cops, too: 'Another lesson to be had there'
Much to consider.

author: PC Gamer
text:

Help, wanted.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Okay, I wasn't expecting 'Rainbow Six XCOM' to be one of my favourite Gamescom demos
And yet, here we are.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Despite horrendous layoffs, obscene hardware prices, and everything else, Saber Interactive exec says 'this is a great time to be in the industry'
Saber CCO Tim Willits believes the availability of platforms like Fortnite and mobile devices are what really matters.

author: PC Gamer
text:

author: PC Gamer
text:
Worried about Onimusha's difficulty after the demo? I have the death count to prove the full game's got teeth
Plenty of challenge awaits in Onimusha: Way of the Sword once you get past the game's opening hours.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Pimax Dream Air review
Unbeatable visuals, excellent comfort, and mediocre tracking.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Total War: Warhammer 40,000 is a sandbox that Creative Assembly will keep adding to rather than making sequels: 'The true experience is the sandbox'

author: PC Gamer
text:
This video of a power supply blowing up shows why you should never cheap out on your PSU
New fear unlocked.

author: PC Gamer
text:

I don't think this was meant to be shown so early.

author: PC Gamer
text:

Lie, robot.

text:

Gordon who?

text:

text:

text:

author: PC Gamer
text:

We're in the hands of the gods now.

author: PC Gamer
text:

text:

author: PC Gamer
text:
